Reduce the IUCN Red List table of a run to the category of each species and to counts

Source: R/iucn.R
summarise_iucn_registry.Rd

Reads the species table that Module 11 writes with the assessments of get_iucn_data() (9_Visualization/tables/TABLE_species_all_data.csv) and returns three tables that hold no assessment content: the species registry with iucn_found, iucn_category and iucn_category_name as its only IUCN columns, and two count tables. Under the IUCN Red List Terms of Use (version 3.1), IUCN places no restriction on the use of the category of a named taxon (section 3), whereas the assessments themselves are not to be redistributed (section 4); counts are published with the citation of the Red List and its version (section 6). The figures of endemism, threats and habitats of Tutorial 3 are drawn from the count tables.

Usage

summarise_iucn_registry(
  species_table,
  redlist_version,
  access_date,
  output_dir = NULL
)

Arguments

species_table

A data frame, or the path to the CSV file, with the columns of the species registry and of get_iucn_data().

redlist_version

Character. Version of the Red List the assessments were taken from, as rredlist::rl_version() reports it (e.g., "2026-1").

access_date

Character. Date the assessments were retrieved, YYYY-MM-DD.

output_dir

Character or NULL. Folder where the three tables are written as TABLE_species_registry.csv, TABLE_iucn_endemic_by_country.csv and TABLE_iucn_classes.csv. NULL (the default) writes nothing.

Value

A list of three tibbles:

  • registry: the species table without its iucn_ columns other than iucn_found, iucn_category and iucn_category_name, and without the checklist columns checklist_fullName, checklist_author, checklist_rank, checklist_taxon and checklist_uuid (the checklist of Korotkova et al. 2021 may be used but not redistributed);

  • endemic_by_country: country, iucn_category, n (endemic species of each country in each category), redlist_version, access_date;

  • classes: field (threat, habitat or endemic_species_in_tree), class, n, redlist_version, access_date. The row of endemic_species_in_tree (class all) is the number of endemic species, each counted once.

Details

The counts cover the ingroup species in the maximum-likelihood tree (is_ingroup and in_ml_tree true), as the figures of Tutorial 3 do. Countries, threats and habitats are split on "; ", the separator get_iucn_data() writes, so a species is counted once in every country, threat class or habitat class it has.

References

IUCN (2026). The IUCN Red List of Threatened Species. Version 2026-1. https://www.iucnredlist.org

Examples

if (FALSE) { # \dontrun{
summarise_iucn_registry("9_Visualization/tables/TABLE_species_all_data.csv",
                        redlist_version = "2026-1", access_date = "2026-10-15",
                        output_dir = "9_Visualization/tables")
} # }
